description:
## Context

**Depends on ticket 3** (extract `flush_effects/1` from `advance/1`) — `flush_effects/1` must exist before this change.

In `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex`:

`handle_cast({:ui_fire, ui_msg})` (L557–560) calls `advance(new_state)`, which runs `flush_effects` (i.e., `maybe_suspend` + `maybe_launch_editor`) before rendering. But `handle_call({:ui_request, msg})` (L541–554) calls `render_frame` directly — it skips `flush_effects` entirely:

```elixir
# handle_cast path — flush_effects runs (inside advance):
def handle_cast({:ui_fire, ui_msg}, state) do
  {new_state, _reply} = handle_ui_request(state, ui_msg)
  advance(new_state)
end

# handle_call path — flush_effects does NOT run:
def handle_call({:ui_request, msg}, from, state) do
  {new_state, reply} = handle_ui_request(state, msg)
  case reply do
    :pending ->
      new_state = put_dialog_from(new_state, from)
      new_state = render_frame(new_state)           # ← no flush_effects
      {:noreply, new_state, loader_timeout(new_state)}
    val ->
      new_state = render_frame(new_state)           # ← no flush_effects
      {:reply, val, new_state, loader_timeout(new_state)}
  end
end
```

Both go through `handle_ui_request`. Only the cast path drains pending side effects. This is not observable today — `suspend_pending` and `editor_pending` are only set by `dispatch_app_action("app.suspend")` (L1152) and `dispatch_app_action("app.editor.external")` (L1181), which are exclusively reachable through the key-event `handle_info` path. But it is a latent correctness trap: any future `handle_ui_request` clause that sets those flags would silently fail to fire through the call path.

## Changes

### 1. `handle_call({:ui_request, msg})` — insert `flush_effects` after `handle_ui_request`

Replace L541–554:
```elixir
def handle_call({:ui_request, msg}, from, state) do
  {new_state, reply} = handle_ui_request(state, msg)
  new_state = flush_effects(new_state)              # ← added

  case reply do
    :pending ->
      new_state = put_dialog_from(new_state, from)
      new_state = render_frame(new_state)
      {:noreply, new_state, loader_timeout(new_state)}

    val ->
      new_state = render_frame(new_state)
      {:reply, val, new_state, loader_timeout(new_state)}
  end
end
```

### 2. `handle_call({:ui_request, {:custom, factory, _kw}})` — also insert `flush_effects`

Replace L531–539:
```elixir
def handle_call({:ui_request, {:custom, factory, _kw}}, from, state) do
  interactive_pid = self()
  tui = %{request_render: fn -> send(interactive_pid, :force_render) end}
  theme = build_custom_theme(state)
  done = fn result -> send(interactive_pid, {:custom_done, from, result}) end
  component = factory.(tui, theme, done)
  new_state = flush_effects(%{state | custom_widget: {from, component}})  # ← flush_effects replaces direct struct update
  new_state = render_frame(new_state)
  {:noreply, new_state, loader_timeout(new_state)}
end
```

## Verification

- Run `mix test apps/octo_pi_tui/`. All existing tests must pass — behavior is identical in all current usage scenarios.
- If Interactive integration tests exercise `handle_call({:ui_request, ...})`, confirm they still pass.
title: Apply `flush_effects/1` in `handle_call` ui_request paths
